title: Understanding MapReduce
text: MapReduce is a programming model used for processing large data sets with a distributed algorithm on a cluster. It involves two main tasks: Map and Reduce.

title: Memory Buffer in MapReduce
text: Consider how MapReduce processes data. Does it require loading all data into memory at once?

title: Data Processing in MapReduce
text: MapReduce processes data in chunks, not all at once. Therefore, it does not require a memory buffer large enough to load all data from disk to memory.
